description: This file defines the Encryption interface, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting strings, intended for maintaining secret information.

classes.name: Encryption
classes.description: Interface defining methods for encrypting and decrypting string data.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string value, possibly using a key, and returns the encrypted string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted string value and returns the original string.
